note: Reopened 2026-10-24 at the owner's request ('revisit'; the owner did not sign off the earlier controller rejection, which was reverted). Re-examination of frames 08, 16, 24 of roll WHPO-P02724 (NARA scope note: Clinton with Havel, and with Albright, Christopher, Lake, Stephanopoulos in the Oval Office, photographed by Bob McNeely 1993-04-20). Frame 16 (window bay, Resolute desk, heavy gold drapes, Clinton, Albright, Christopher) and frame 24 (fireplace wall, cream wing chairs, Clinton with Havel) are the Oval Office. Frame 08 shows Albright, Christopher and a man with a folder but no Clinton; a French door with lighter chintz-trimmed curtains, a floral chintz armchair, a radiator grille and a framed photograph; the drapes and chairs match neither frame 16 nor 24. A flat wall is not conclusive from a close crop. Verdict: probably a different room of the same visit (adjoining West Wing room, unidentified), not proven. The alt text 'speaking with ... in the Oval Office' is unsupported for this frame (no President in view). Left open for the owner; the room albright-oval-office-1993 does not use it.

Owner ruling 2026-10-24: rejected as an Oval Office basis photo. The room is not identified, and the caption "Clinton speaking with Albright in the Oval Office" is unsupported (frame 08 of roll WHPO-P02724). Frames 16 and 24 show the gold drapes, the Resolute desk and the cream wing chairs, which frame 08 lacks.
